actionable_consensus: Preserve PEFT target_parameters for the V290/V291 MoE adapter lineage.
Prefer PeftModel.from_pretrained(..., is_trainable=True) over manual state_dict injection.
Block paid jobs until CPU round-trip proves adapter config, safetensors keys, trainable tensors, and gradients.
Do not promote by eval_loss; promote only by weak/full ACC and truncation gates.
Do not repeat broad SFT, longer epochs, or H200 runs without a new CPU gate.
implemented_changes: hf_job_train_v90 default INIT_ADAPTER_LOAD_MODE changed to peft.
hf_job_preflight_gate blocks manual load when target_parameters exist.
kg1_static_safety_gate blocks active launchers with manual load and MoE target_parameters.
Roadmap rewritten as active-only plan with old details archived.
hf_job_preflight_gate logs and blocks non-empty modules_to_save under strict init-adapter config.
package_hf_adapter_submission blocks non-empty modules_to_save in final packages.
second_pass_additions: modules_to_save must be empty; lm_head is allowed only as LoRA target_modules, not as a full saved module.
P2 round-trip gate must include adapter_config SHA and safetensors key/shape/dtype fingerprints before and after save/reload.
P3 smoke must include weak micro-ACC kill-switch and answer-span loss component logging, not eval_loss alone.
next_required_step: Implement V485 CPU PEFT round-trip gate before any paid GPU smoke.
